title: add benchmark-lab performance suites, profiling baselines, representative runners, and reporting pipeline v131
author: Jared Kline
description: This PR adds a new set of performance test suites, updated profiling baselines, representative workload runners, and an end-to-end reporting pipeline for Benchmark Lab (v131). Motivation: we've seen variance in kernel-selection profiles and adaptive-batching behavior across recent hardware; this change standardizes suites for cross-run comparability and improves reporting so SRE and runtime teams can quickly identify regressions. The change set includes: 1) new performance suites (short/medium/long sequence distributions) with deterministic seeds and warmup flows, 2) profiling baselines for kernel selection and KV-cache cold/warm scenarios, 3) representative workload runners for chat, completion, and streaming workloads with configurable load profiles, 4) a reporting pipeline DAG that ingests runner outputs, computes metric aggregates, and uploads dashboards/alerts. Checklist: [x] deterministic seeds & env vars, [x] CI job for benchmark-lab smoke, [x] docs for running locally, [x] export hooks for reporting. Related Linear: ENG-2105, ENG-2344. Related Jira (support escalations): SUP-324. Notes: kept diffs small and targeted; the reporting pipeline is opt-in and behind a feature flag to avoid sudden load on telemetry ingestion during rollout.

review_comments: Priya Raman: Please add deterministic seeds and note how they interact with the randomness in our kernel-selection sampler. Also we should ensure the run IDs are stable for reporting.
Jared Kline: Added deterministic seeding across suites and a run_id template (timestamp+suite+seed). Documented in README and runbook.
Sofia Martinez: Can the reporting DAG handle partial runner failures? Add retry logic and a dead-letter export so we don't lose data.
Jared Kline: Added retries with exponential backoff and a 'failed-runs' bucket in the exporter. Also added smoke tests to exercise failure paths.

Ethan Wu: CI flakes on GPU infra were observed in previous runs — added resource limits and extended timeouts to benchmarks.yml. Considered feature-flagging the heavier suites behind 'benchmark_v131_enabled'.
Priya Raman: Approved after verifying baseline numbers and run reproducibility locally.
release_notes: Adds new standardized performance suites, updated profiling baselines, representative runners, and a reporting pipeline (v131). Opt-in behind feature flag. Improves baseline reproducibility and reporting coverage for kernel selection and KV-cache scenarios.
testing_notes: Local reproducibility verified on a T4/GPU staging pool. Smoke suite completes in ~12m on CI with extended timeouts. Added unit tests for transforms and an integration test for the DAG run (uses a small synthetic runner output).
perf_results_summary: Representative workloads: throughput +12% (median) for short sequences due to improved batching alignment; p95 latency reduced ~8% in medium sequences with updated kernel-selection baseline. KV-cache warm hit rate stability improved; cold-start variance reduced by 20% compared to previous baselines. Reporting pipeline now surfaces kernel selection distribution and kv_cache_hit_rate per-run.
